page: Microsoft Azure F64amds_v7 is a memory-intensive server belonging to the Famdsv7 family, powered by an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs running at a clock speed of 4.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The server is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per core. Storage is bundled as a local NVMe SSD with a capacity of 7559 GB, and the instance is premium storage capable. It operates under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

In benchmark evaluations, the F64amds_v7 demonstrates top-tier performance, placing in the top 10% for both single-core and multi-core stress-ng CPU tests. Memory performance is similarly robust, with read-only small block cached bandwidth reaching 11893.77 GB/sec and large block uncached write bandwidth at 193.26 GB/sec. The processor's instruction set extensions, including AVX-512 and cryptography accelerations like AES and SHA_NI, contribute to top-tier scores in Passmark CPU extended instructions and encryption tests. Database operations and Redis SET operations also rank in the top 10%, with Redis handling 170.17 million operations per second.

Given its high memory-to-vCPU ratio and substantial local NVMe storage, the F64amds_v7 offers high resource density and qualitative cost efficiency for memory-heavy and I/O-intensive workloads. It is highly suitable for large-scale database deployments, in-memory caching systems like Redis, data compression tasks, and static web serving. Additionally, the high-frequency AMD EPYC cores and vector instruction support make it capable of handling medium-sized LLM inference tasks efficiently without dedicated GPU hardware.
